supplements.title: An Open-Label Pilot Intervention Trial to Prevent Diabetes in Prediabetic Adult Survivors of Childhood Cancer
supplements.summary: A combined metformin and digital lifestyle program safely helps prevent diabetes in prediabetic childhood cancer survivors.

supplements.title: Cepharanthine Reverses Gefitinib Resistance in NSCLC by Concurrently Inhibiting AKT/P70S6K Survival Signaling and Activating STING-Mediated Immune Response.
supplements.summary: Cepharanthine overcomes lung cancer drug resistance by blocking survival signals and activating immune responses against resistant tumor cells.

supplements.title: Design, synthesis and biological evaluation of novel ursolic acid derivatives as potent anti-pancreatic cancer agents.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed a modified ursolic acid compound (MG9) that effectively kills pancreatic cancer cells by triggering cell death pathways.

supplements.title: Kaempferol ameliorates PCOS by alleviating metabolic and endocrine abnormalities as well as oxidative stress.
supplements.summary: Kaempferol, a plant compound, reduces hormonal imbalances, insulin resistance, and oxidative stress in rats with polycystic ovary syndrome.

supplements.title: Protective effects of dihydroartemisinin against sterile inflammation and oxidative stress in alveolar macrophages.
supplements.summary: Dihydroartemisinin, derived from Artemisia annua, protects lung cells from oxidative stress and inflammation in acute lung injury.

supplements.title: Amine functionalized TiO2 doped mesoporous bioactive glass coated curcumin infused 3d printed poly (L-lactic acid): A promising multifunctional scaffold with enhanced osteogenesis and tumour relapse inhibition characteristics.
supplements.summary: A 3D-printed scaffold combining curcumin and bioactive glass coating kills osteosarcoma cells while promoting bone regeneration.

supplements.title: Rationally designed BTO@MSN@PPy-PEG piezoelectric nanozyme for ultrasound/NIR-triggered synergistic piezodynamic-photothermal-chemo tumor therapy.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed nanoparticles combining ultrasound and laser activation to deliver triple therapy—piezoelectric, heat, and chemotherapy—for more effective tumor treatment.

supplements.title: Parthenolide inhibits the progression of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma by promoting ferroptosis through inhibiting UBD.
supplements.summary: Parthenolide, a natural compound, slows intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma growth by triggering cancer cell death through a specific molecular pathway.

supplements.title: Resveratrol inhibits aerobic glycolysis and promotes cuproptosis in acute myeloid leukemia via the PI3K/AKT signaling pathway.
supplements.summary: Resveratrol kills acute myeloid leukemia cells by blocking a growth pathway and triggering copper-dependent cell death.

supplements.title: Targeting p38α, p38γ, and ERα with bioactive compounds from royal jelly for anti-breast cancer activity: A comprehensive in-silico study using fingerprint analysis, molecular dynamics, MEP, and PCA.
supplements.summary: Royal jelly compounds chrysin, galangin, and naringin show promise against breast cancer by binding strongly to key cancer-related proteins.

supplements.title: Ginkgetin enhances the antitumor effect of Taxol on human breast cancer MCF-7 cells via ferroptosis mediated by the MDM2-p53-YAP1 axis.
supplements.summary: Ginkgetin combined with Taxol enhances breast cancer cell death by triggering a natural cell death process called ferroptosis.

supplements.title: Vitamin D receptor isoform VDRA suppresses hepatocellular tumorigenesis by restricting YAP nuclear localization.
supplements.summary: A vitamin D receptor variant called VDRA suppresses liver cancer by blocking the cancer-promoting protein YAP from entering cell nuclei.

supplements.title: Nanoliposomal Eucommia ulmoides extract limits PANoptosis in sepsis-induced acute lung injury through a TGF-β1-JNK pathway.
supplements.summary: A nanoparticle form of plant extract reduced harmful immune cell death in sepsis-related lung injury through a specific cellular pathway.

supplements.title: Prevent 6:1 trial: pI rotocol for a feasibility trial of a 6:1 intermittent diet for weight gain prevention in women at increased risk of breast cancer.
supplements.summary: A weekly fasting day diet is being tested to prevent weight gain in women at high risk of breast cancer.

supplements.title: A Curcumin-Derived HSP70 Inhibitor Disrupts Lysosomal Function to Suppress Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Progression.
supplements.summary: A curcumin-derived compound targets HSP70 protein to disrupt lysosomes, effectively suppressing triple-negative breast cancer growth and metastasis.

off_label.title: Intranasal Ketamine for Existential Distress in Advanced Cancer.
off_label.summary: Intranasal ketamine rapidly reduces depression and existential distress in advanced cancer patients receiving palliative care.

off_label.title: An Open-Label Pilot Intervention Trial to Prevent Diabetes in Prediabetic Adult Survivors of Childhood Cancer
off_label.summary: A combined metformin and digital lifestyle program safely helps prevent diabetes in prediabetic childhood cancer survivors.

off_label.title: Topical Ruxolitinib as a Treatment of Anti-PD1 Induced Lichenoid Skin Toxicities: a Prospective Single-center Pilot Study
off_label.summary: Topical ruxolitinib cream may effectively treat skin rashes caused by anti-PD1 cancer immunotherapy, according to this pilot study of 22 patients.

off_label.title: Genetic characteristics and targeted treatments of primary bladder and urachal adenocarcinomas: a systematic review with pooled descriptive genomic analyses.
off_label.summary: Researchers cataloged genetic mutations and targeted drug treatments for rare bladder adenocarcinomas to guide personalized patient care decisions.

off_label.title: Association of MUC3A P258S mutation with advanced phase CML structural and in silico insights.
off_label.summary: A novel MUC3A mutation found exclusively in advanced chronic myeloid leukemia may serve as a progression biomarker and improve treatment response to Capmatinib.

off_label.title: The Effect of the Anticonvulsant Topiramate on Acetylcholine-Induced Calcium Signals is Linked to Sirt-1 Activity.
off_label.summary: Topiramate enhances acetylcholine-induced calcium signals in neuroblastoma cells through sirtuin-1 activity, revealing a new mechanism for the drug's anticonvulsant effects.

off_label.title: Evaluation of Combined Treatment With Atorvastatin and SREBP2 Inhibitors Against Colorectal Cancer Cells Under Two-dimensional and Three-dimensional Culture Models.
off_label.summary: Combining atorvastatin with SREBP2 inhibitors increases killing of colorectal cancer cells in laboratory models.

off_label.title: Sulfasalazine an Inhibitor of System xC - (Cystine/glutamate Antiporter), Combined With Recombinant Methioninase, Inhibits Both Cancer and Normal Cells, Suggesting Lack of Cancer Selectivity of Cysteine Restriction.
off_label.summary: Combining sulfasalazine and methioninase killed both cancer and normal cells, indicating this approach lacks cancer-selective effectiveness.

off_label.title: Pregabalin for Opioid-resistant Neuropathic Pain in Bone Metastases.
off_label.summary: Pregabalin effectively relieves nerve pain from bone cancer spread when opioids alone don't work.

off_label.title: Metformin Induces PARP1-mediated Cell Death in NPC/HK1 Human Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma Cells.
off_label.summary: Metformin kills nasopharyngeal cancer cells by triggering a DNA repair protein called PARP1 to cause cell death.

off_label.title: Imipramine Targets Apoptosis, Metastasis, and EGFR/SRC-mediated EMT in Oral Cancer Cells.
off_label.summary: Imipramine, an antidepressant drug, kills oral cancer cells and prevents their spread by blocking key growth signals.

off_label.title: Two faces of Amitriptyline in an in vitro study on C6 glioma cells: The effects of Amitriptyline and its combination with Temozolomide and radiation.
off_label.summary: Amitriptyline shows anti-cancer effects on glioma cells but reduces radiation effectiveness and suppresses beneficial immune marker PD-L1.

off_label.title: Metformin enhances survival with immune checkpoint inhibitors in cancer patients: A meta-analysis.
off_label.summary: Metformin combined with immunotherapy significantly improves survival in cancer patients, particularly among Asian populations.

off_label.title: Repurposing Hetrombopag for Multiple Myeloma by Targeting PNPO: A Celastrol-Inspired Approach.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified hetrombopag as a drug that blocks PNPO, an enzyme overactive in multiple myeloma, stopping cancer cell growth and extending patient survival.

off_label.title: Mebendazole impairs the expression and function of enzymes in nucleotide metabolism pathways, leading to Selective Cytotoxicity, Cell Cycle Arrest, and Damage to Cell Morphology in Gastric Cancer.
off_label.summary: Mebendazole blocks nucleotide-making enzymes in gastric cancer cells, stopping their growth while sparing healthy cells.

biomarkers.title: An Open-Label Pilot Intervention Trial to Prevent Diabetes in Prediabetic Adult Survivors of Childhood Cancer
biomarkers.summary: A combined metformin and digital lifestyle program safely helps prevent diabetes in prediabetic childhood cancer survivors.

biomarkers.title: Phase 1/2, First-in-Human, Dose-Escalation Study of X-396 (Ensartinib) in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors and Expansion Phase in Patients With ALK-positive Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
biomarkers.summary: X-396 (ensartinib) is a new drug tested in humans for advanced cancers, with focus on ALK-positive lung cancer effectiveness and safety.

biomarkers.title: A Phase III, Open-label, Randomised Study of Datopotamab Deruxtecan (Dato-DXd) With or Without Durvalumab Compared With Investigator's Choice of Chemotherapy (Paclitaxel, Nab-paclitaxel or Gemcitabine + Carboplatin) in Combination With Pembrolizumab in Patients With PD-L1 Positive Locally Recurrent Inoperable or Metastatic Triple-negative Breast Cancer (TROPION-Breast05)
biomarkers.summary: Datopotamab deruxtecan with or without durvalumab shows promise against metastatic triple-negative breast cancer compared to standard chemotherapy combinations.

biomarkers.title: A Randomized，Multicenter，Prospectie，Controlled Clinical Study on Tumor Budding Guiding Individualized Surgical Planning of Early-stage Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Study tests whether tumor budding patterns can safely guide which early-stage oral cancer patients need lymph node surgery.

biomarkers.title: Extracellular Vesicles as Predictive Biomarkers for Chemotherapy-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy
biomarkers.summary: Blood biomarkers may predict which cancer patients will develop nerve damage from chemotherapy treatment.

biomarkers.title: A Phase II Clinical Study of Trastuzumab Rezetecan (SHR-A1811) or in Combination With Adebrelimab (SHR-1316) for HER2-Expressing Locally Advanced or Metastatic Urothelial Carcinoma (la/mUC)
biomarkers.summary: A study tests a targeted drug alone or combined with an immunotherapy drug for advanced bladder cancer with HER2 mutations.

biomarkers.title: A Phase 2 Study of Olaparib and Cediranib for the Treatment of Recurrent Ovarian Cancer
biomarkers.summary: A Phase 2 trial tests combining olaparib and cediranib to treat recurrent ovarian, peritoneal, and fallopian tube cancer.

biomarkers.title: Predictive Value of Ariscat Risk Index In The Development of Postoperative Pulmonary Complication After Major Abdominal Cancer Surgery
biomarkers.summary: ARISCAT risk index effectively predicts lung complications after major abdominal cancer surgery in patients undergoing general anesthesia.

biomarkers.title: Novel Objective Comparison of Short-term Surgical Outcomes From Total Mesorectal Excision Between Total Neoadjuvant Therapy - Rapido Protocol, Standard Long Course Radiotherapy and Upfront Surgery
biomarkers.summary: RAPIDO chemotherapy protocol improves surgical outcomes in rectal cancer compared to standard radiotherapy or surgery alone.

biomarkers.title: Developing and Optimising the Use of Magnetic Resonance Imaging and Spectroscopy in Radiotherapy (MRinRT) Pathways: Investigating Avenues to Improve Outcomes for Patients and the Assessment of Treatment Response.
biomarkers.summary: Study investigates whether MRI scans improve radiotherapy planning and treatment adaptation compared to CT scans alone.

biomarkers.title: The ENDOCancer-DATA: the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results Database Program on Endometrial Cancer in the Italian Population
biomarkers.summary: Italian study collecting clinical data from 10,000 endometrial cancer patients to analyze treatment outcomes and molecular characteristics.

biomarkers.title: HU-F-AIM - A Prospective, Interventional Study to Evaluate HU-resistance in Polycythemia Vera Patients Who Meet Predictive Parameters Identified in the Machine Learning Project PV-AIM
biomarkers.summary: Researchers tested machine learning-identified markers to predict which polycythemia vera patients would fail hydroxyurea treatment.

biomarkers.title: Manipulation of the Enteral Microbiome by Fecal Microbiota Transplantation Among Adult Patients With Malignant Hematological Diseases
biomarkers.summary: Fecal microbiota transplantation restores healthy gut bacteria in blood cancer patients damaged by chemotherapy, reducing infections and improving quality of life.

biomarkers.title: A Randomized Phase II Study of Neo-adjuvant Chemo/Immunotherapy Versus Chemotherapy Alone for the Treatment of Locally Advanced and Potentially Resectable Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) Patients.
biomarkers.summary: A study comparing chemotherapy plus immunotherapy versus chemotherapy alone in lung cancer patients to improve complete tumor elimination before surgery.

biomarkers.title: A Phase 3 Open-Label, Randomized, Multicenter Study of Rocbrutinib (LP-168) vs Pirtobrutinib in Covalent BTK Inhibitor (cBTKi) Pretreated Relapsed or Refractory Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) / Small Lymphocytic Lymphoma (SLL) Subjects
biomarkers.summary: A Phase 3 trial compares rocbrutinib versus pirtobrutinib in relapsed or refractory chronic lymphocytic leukemia patients.

trials.title: Prescribing practices for menopausal hormone therapy in France in 2025: A national online survey (MENOPRAT).
trials.summary: French gynecologists' hormone therapy prescribing practices for menopause vary, with some using alternatives due to perceived barriers.

trials.title: A Qualitative Study of the Implementation of Referral Coordination for Specialty Care Referrals in the Veterans Health Administration.
trials.summary: The VA implemented a referral coordination system where clinicians review and discuss specialty care options with veterans before scheduling appointments.

trials.title: Perspectives and Requirements of Patients with Prostate Cancer on Mobile Health Interventions During Androgen Deprivation Therapy: A Descriptive Qualitative Study.
trials.summary: Prostate cancer patients undergoing hormone therapy want mobile health tools to manage their treatment side effects and improve daily care.

trials.title: Intranasal Ketamine for Existential Distress in Advanced Cancer.

trials.summary: A study tests combining two drugs against standard treatment in men with advanced prostate cancer that resists hormone therapy.

trials.title: Phase III Study of Adaptive Stereostactic Body Radiotherapy With Dose-escalation on the Dominant Intraprostatic Lesion for High-risk Prostate Cancer: ORION Trial Protocol
trials.summary: A clinical trial tests whether targeted radiation therapy with higher doses on dominant prostate tumors improves outcomes in high-risk prostate cancer patients.

trials.title: An Open-Label Pilot Intervention Trial to Prevent Diabetes in Prediabetic Adult Survivors of Childhood Cancer
trials.summary: A combined metformin and digital lifestyle program safely helps prevent diabetes in prediabetic childhood cancer survivors.

trials.title: A Phase 3, Randomized, Open-label, Multicenter Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Sacituzumab Tirumotecan Maintenance Treatment With or Without Bevacizumab Versus Standard of Care After Second-line Platinum-based Doublet Chemotherapy in Participants With Platinum-sensitive Recurrent Ovarian Cancer (TroFuse-022/ENGOT-ov84/GOG-3103)
trials.summary: Study tests if sacituzumab tirumotecan with or without bevacizumab extends survival in platinum-sensitive recurrent ovarian cancer patients.

trials.title: Financial Toxicity in Patients With Resected Soft Tissue and Bone Sarcomas
trials.summary: Study examines financial stress and quality-of-life impacts on bone and soft tissue sarcoma patients undergoing surgery.

trials.title: Phase 1/2, First-in-Human, Dose-Escalation Study of X-396 (Ensartinib) in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors and Expansion Phase in Patients With ALK-positive Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
trials.summary: X-396 (ensartinib) is a new drug tested in humans for advanced cancers, with focus on ALK-positive lung cancer effectiveness and safety.

trials.summary: Datopotamab deruxtecan with or without durvalumab shows promise against metastatic triple-negative breast cancer compared to standard chemotherapy combinations.

trials.summary: Melflufen combined with dexamethasone shows promise treating multiple myeloma patients resistant to standard therapies in real-world clinical practice.

trials.title: A Randomized, Open-label, Phase 3 Study to Evaluate 9MW2821 Versus Investigator's Choice of Chemotherapy in Participants With Locally Advanced or Metastatic Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Who Have Previously Received Taxane-based Chemotherapy With or Without Immunotherapy and an Antibody-drug Conjugate With a Topoisomerase Inhibitor Payload
trials.summary: Study compares a new drug (9MW2821) to standard chemotherapy for advanced triple-negative breast cancer in previously treated patients.

trials.summary: Study tests whether tumor budding patterns can safely guide which early-stage oral cancer patients need lymph node surgery.

trials.summary: Blood biomarkers may predict which cancer patients will develop nerve damage from chemotherapy treatment.

mind_body.title: Intranasal Ketamine for Existential Distress in Advanced Cancer.
mind_body.summary: Intranasal ketamine rapidly reduces depression and existential distress in advanced cancer patients receiving palliative care.

mind_body.title: Efficacy and safety of acupuncture for breast cancer-related insomnia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
mind_body.summary: Acupuncture may improve sleep quality in breast cancer patients with insomnia, though evidence strength remains low due to methodological limitations.

mind_body.title: Decreasing Chemotherapy Induced Distress Using Immersive Virtual Reality in Patients With Cancer
mind_body.summary: Virtual reality during chemotherapy significantly reduces patient distress, anxiety, depression, and pain compared to standard care.

mind_body.title: Spiritual Well-Being and Hope in Oncology Patients.
mind_body.summary: Cancer patients show high spiritual well-being and hope levels, with hope significantly strengthening spiritual well-being.

mind_body.title: Yoga for Patients Undergoing Thoracic Radiotherapy and Their Family Caregivers: Results of a Randomized Controlled Trial.
mind_body.summary: Yoga involving thoracic cancer patients and their family caregivers improved quality of life better than education alone during radiotherapy treatment.

mind_body.title: Attitudes, Practices, and Barriers to Spiritual Care for Patients With Cancer: An International Survey.
mind_body.summary: Oncology clinicians recognize spiritual care as important but face significant barriers to providing it to cancer patients in practice.

mind_body.title: Analysis of the circRNA/lncRNA-miRNA-mRNA Networks of Action of Fire Needle Acupuncture in Relieving Chemotherapy-Induced Neuropathic Pain.
mind_body.summary: Fire needle acupuncture may relieve chemotherapy-induced nerve pain through specific molecular pathways, offering a potential treatment alternative.

mind_body.title: Social prescribing for people recovering from treatment for cancer: a systematic scoping review.
mind_body.summary: Social prescribing—connecting cancer survivors with community activities—helps address emotional and social challenges during recovery.

mind_body.title: Exploring psychosocial outcomes of fly-fishing retreats for cancer survivors: A qualitative study.
mind_body.summary: Fly-fishing retreats help cancer survivors improve their wellbeing through nature-based activities and social connection.

mind_body.title: A mixed-methods longitudinal study of demoralization and depression in breast cancer survivors.
mind_body.summary: Breast cancer survivors commonly experience demoralization and depression after treatment, conditions that warrant separate clinical attention and further study.

mind_body.title: [The effect of physiotherapy treatments on the immune system].
mind_body.summary: Exercise and physiotherapy strengthen immune defenses against tumors by boosting natural killer cells and reducing inflammation.

mind_body.title: Treatment of neuropathic pain in cancer survivors: a scoping review of pharmacological, exercise, and psychosocial interventions.
mind_body.summary: Cancer survivors can manage neuropathic pain through medications, exercise, and psychological treatments, according to a comprehensive research review.

mind_body.title: [Moxibustion enhances the antitumor efficacy of Trametinib in breast cancer-bearing mice via MEK/ERK signaling pathway].
mind_body.summary: Moxibustion combined with Trametinib drug treatment more effectively slows breast cancer growth in mice than either treatment alone.

mind_body.title: [Effect of electroacupuncture on microglial polarization and activity of α7nAChR-TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB signaling pathway in the anterior cingulate cortex of rats with chronic inflammatory pain-depression comorbidity].
mind_body.summary: Electroacupuncture reduces pain and depression in rats by changing how brain immune cells respond through a specific cellular pathway.

mind_body.title: Feasibility and acceptability of a stress-management behavioral weight loss intervention for Black breast cancer survivors.
mind_body.summary: A stress management weight loss program for Black breast cancer survivors proved feasible, acceptable, and achieved significant weight loss and stress reduction.
